descriptions.text: Argentine President Javier Milei promoted a cryptocurrency called $LIBRA on social media. Following his endorsement, the token's price surged rapidly but later suffered a severe crash.

On February 14, 2025, the Solana-based LIBRA memecoin surged after Argentine President Javier Milei promoted its launch. Insiders controlling most token supply rapidly extracted liquidity via Meteora pools, crashing the price 90% within hours. Over $251 million was lost by retail investors, while legal probes and over $120 million in asset freezes followed. No restitution to victims is confirmed, and specific contract exposures remain unarchived. Insiders with unchecked control over LIBRA’s token supply and Meteora pool liquidity could withdraw funds at will. The token contract lacked vesting, liquidity withdrawal constraints, and robust administrative controls.…
